- name: Install and configure PostgreSQL 15
  hosts: db_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  collections:
    - community.postgresql

  vars:
    postgres_version: 15
    pg_listen_addresses: "*"
    allowed_cidrs:
      - 10.0.0.0/8
      - 192.168.0.0/16
    pg_db_name: appdb
    pg_app_user: appuser
    pg_app_password: ""
    pg_extensions: []

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure required variables are set
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - pg_app_password is string
          - pg_app_password | length >= 12
        fail_msg: "pg_app_password must be provided and at least 12 characters long."
        quiet: true

    - name: Set platform-specific variables
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pg_service_name: >-
          {{ 'postgresql' if ansible_facts.os_family in ['Debian'] else 'postgresql-' ~ postgres_version }}
        pg_hba_path: >-
          {{ '/etc/postgresql/' ~ postgres_version ~ '/main/pg_hba.conf' if ansible_facts.os_family in ['Debian']
             else '/var/lib/pgsql/' ~ postgres_version ~ '/data/pg_hba.conf' }}
        pg_data_dir: >-
          {{ '/var/lib/postgresql/' ~ postgres_version ~ '/main' if ansible_facts.os_family in ['Debian']
             else '/var/lib/pgsql/' ~ postgres_version ~ '/data' }}
        pg_socket_dir: >-
          {{ '/var/run/postgresql' if ansible_facts.os_family in ['Debian'] else '/var/lib/pgsql' }}
        pg_bin_prefix: >-
          {{ '' if ansible_facts.os_family in ['Debian'] else '/usr/pgsql-' ~ postgres_version ~ '/bin/' }}

    - name: Calculate memory-based tuning values
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        mem_mb: "{{ ansible_facts.memtotal_mb | int }}"
        shared_buffers_mb: "{{ [ (ansible_facts.memtotal_mb | int * 0.25) | int, 8192 ] | min | int | max(512) }}"
        effective_cache_size_mb: "{{ (ansible_facts.memtotal_mb | int * 0.5) | int }}"
        maintenance_work_mem_mb: "{{ [ (ansible_facts.memtotal_mb | int * 0.05) | int, 2048 ] | min | int | max(128) }}"
        work_mem_mb: 16

  tasks:
    - name: Install PGDG repository on Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.include_tasks: install_pgdg_debian.yml
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Install PGDG repository on RHEL/CentOS/Alma/Rocky
      ansible.builtin.include_tasks: install_pgdg_redhat.yml
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Install PostgreSQL 15 and dependencies (Debian/Ubuntu)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - "postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}"
          - "postgresql-client-{{ postgres_version }}"
          - postgresql-contrib
          - python3-psycopg2
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Install PostgreSQL 15 and dependencies (RHEL family)
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-server"
          - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}"
          - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-contrib"
          - python3-psycopg2
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Initialize database cluster if needed (RHEL family)
      ansible.builtin.command: "{{ pg_bin_prefix }}postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}-setup initdb"
      args:
        creates: "{{ pg_data_dir }}/PG_VERSION"
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'RedHat'
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL service enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Configure pg_hba.conf with secure rules
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: "{{ pg_hba_path }}"
        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED ACCESS RULES"
        insertbefore: BOF
        create: false
        block: |
          # Allow postgres superuser via local socket using peer auth
          local   all             postgres                                peer
          # Local connections use peer auth (system user mapping)
          local   all             all                                     peer
          # IPv4 local connections:
          host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            scram-sha-256
          # IPv6 local connections:
          host    all             all             ::1/128                 scram-sha-256
          # Application/remote networks (scram-sha-256):
          {% for cidr in allowed_cidrs %}
          host    all             all             {{ cidr }}              scram-sha-256
          {% endfor %}
      notify: Reload PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL parameters for production
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_set:
        name: "{{ item.name }}"
        value: "{{ item.value }}"
      loop:
        - { name: "listen_addresses", value: "{{ pg_listen_addresses }}" }
        - { name: "password_encryption", value: "scram-sha-256" }
        - { name: "ssl", value: "on" }
        - { name: "max_connections", value: "200" }
        - { name: "shared_buffers", value: "{{ shared_buffers_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "effective_cache_size", value: "{{ effective_cache_size_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "maintenance_work_mem", value: "{{ maintenance_work_mem_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "work_mem", value: "{{ work_mem_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "wal_level", value: "replica" }
        - { name: "synchronous_commit", value: "on" }
        - { name: "checkpoint_completion_target", value: "0.9" }
        - { name: "max_wal_size", value: "4GB" }
        - { name: "min_wal_size", value: "1GB" }
        - { name: "random_page_cost", value: "1.1" }
        - { name: "effective_io_concurrency", value: "200" }
        - { name: "logging_collector", value: "on" }
        - { name: "log_line_prefix", value: "%m [%p] %q%u@%d " }
        - { name: "log_min_duration_statement", value: "1000" }
      vars:
        ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Enable pg_stat_statements if requested
      when: "'pg_stat_statements' in pg_extensions"
      become_user: postgres
      block:
        - name: Ensure shared_preload_libraries includes pg_stat_statements
          community.postgresql.postgresql_set:
            name: shared_preload_libraries
            value: "pg_stat_statements"
          notify: Restart PostgreSQL

        - name: Create extension pg_stat_statements in database
          community.postgresql.postgresql_ext:
            name: pg_stat_statements
            db: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
            state: present
          vars:
            login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

    - name: Ensure database user exists
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: "{{ pg_app_user }}"
        password: "{{ pg_app_password }}"
        encrypted: true
        state: present
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"
      no_log: true

    - name: Ensure database exists and owned by user
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_db:
        name: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
        owner: "{{ pg_app_user }}"
        encoding: "UTF8"
        state: present
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

    - name: Install requested extensions into database
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_ext:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        db: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
        state: present
      loop: "{{ pg_extensions | difference(['pg_stat_statements']) }}"
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

  handlers:
    - name: Restart PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: restarted

    - name: Reload PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: reloaded

  tasks_from: ""

- name: Install PGDG repository for Debian/Ubuntu
  hosts: db_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure keyring directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /usr/share/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository signing key
      ansible.builtin.apt_key:
        url: https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
        state: present
        keyring: /usr/share/keyrings/postgresql.gpg

    - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/postgresql.gpg] http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt {{ ansible_facts.distribution_release }}-pgdg main"
        filename: "pgdg"
        state: present

    - name: Update APT cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
  vars:
    ansible_facts:
      distribution_release: "{{ ansible_distribution_release }}"
  when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'
  tags: [install_pgdg_debian]

- name: Install PGDG repository for RHEL family
  hosts: db_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Install PGDG repository RPM
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_facts.distribution_major_version }}-{{ ansible_facts.architecture }}/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
        state: present

    - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module
      ansible.builtin.command: dnf -qy module disable postgresql
      args:
        warn: false
      register: disable_module
      changed_when: "'Nothing to do.' not in disable_module.stdout"

  when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'RedHat'
  tags: [install_pgdg_redhat]

        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED ACCESS RULES"
        insertbefore: BOF
        create: false
        block: |
          # Allow postgres superuser via local socket using peer auth
          local   all             postgres                                peer
          # Local connections use peer auth (system user mapping)
          local   all             all                                     peer
          # IPv4 local connections:
          host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            scram-sha-256
          # IPv6 local connections:
          host    all             all             ::1/128                 scram-sha-256
          # Application/remote networks (scram-sha-256):
          {% for cidr in allowed_cidrs %}
          host    all             all             {{ cidr }}              scram-sha-256
          {% endfor %}
      notify: Reload PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL parameters for production
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_set:
        name: "{{ item.name }}"
        value: "{{ item.value }}"
      loop:
        - { name: "listen_addresses", value: "{{ pg_listen_addresses }}" }
        - { name: "password_encryption", value: "scram-sha-256" }
        - { name: "ssl", value: "on" }
        - { name: "max_connections", value: "200" }
        - { name: "shared_buffers", value: "{{ shared_buffers_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "effective_cache_size", value: "{{ effective_cache_size_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "maintenance_work_mem", value: "{{ maintenance_work_mem_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "work_mem", value: "{{ work_mem_mb }}MB" }
        - { name: "wal_level", value: "replica" }
        - { name: "synchronous_commit", value: "on" }
        - { name: "checkpoint_completion_target", value: "0.9" }
        - { name: "max_wal_size", value: "4GB" }
        - { name: "min_wal_size", value: "1GB" }
        - { name: "random_page_cost", value: "1.1" }
        - { name: "effective_io_concurrency", value: "200" }
        - { name: "logging_collector", value: "on" }
        - { name: "log_line_prefix", value: "%m [%p] %q%u@%d " }
        - { name: "log_min_duration_statement", value: "1000" }
      vars:
        ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Enable pg_stat_statements if requested
      when: "'pg_stat_statements' in pg_extensions"
      become_user: postgres
      block:
        - name: Ensure shared_preload_libraries includes pg_stat_statements
          community.postgresql.postgresql_set:
            name: shared_preload_libraries
            value: "pg_stat_statements"
          notify: Restart PostgreSQL

        - name: Create extension pg_stat_statements in database
          community.postgresql.postgresql_ext:
            name: pg_stat_statements
            db: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
            state: present
          vars:
            login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

    - name: Ensure database user exists
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: "{{ pg_app_user }}"
        password: "{{ pg_app_password }}"
        encrypted: true
        state: present
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"
      no_log: true

    - name: Ensure database exists and owned by user
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_db:
        name: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
        owner: "{{ pg_app_user }}"
        encoding: "UTF8"
        state: present
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

    - name: Install requested extensions into database
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_ext:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        db: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
        state: present
      loop: "{{ pg_extensions | difference(['pg_stat_statements']) }}"
      vars:
        login_unix_socket: "{{ pg_socket_dir }}"

  handlers:
    - name: Restart PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: restarted

    - name: Reload PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: reloaded

  tasks_from: ""

- name: Install PGDG repository for Debian/Ubuntu
  hosts: db_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure keyring directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /usr/share/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository signing key
      ansible.builtin.apt_key:
        url: https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
        state: present
        keyring: /usr/share/keyrings/postgresql.gpg

    - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/postgresql.gpg] http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt {{ ansible_facts.distribution_release }}-pgdg main"
        filename: "pgdg"
        state: present

    - name: Update APT cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
  vars:
    ansible_facts:
      distribution_release: "{{ ansible_distribution_release }}"
  when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'
  tags: [install_pgdg_debian]

- name: Install PGDG repository for RHEL family
  hosts: db_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Install PGDG repository RPM
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_facts.distribution_major_version }}-{{ ansible_facts.architecture }}/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
        state: present

    - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module
      ansible.builtin.command: dnf -qy module disable postgresql
      args:
        warn: false
      register: disable_module
      changed_when: "'Nothing to do.' not in disable_module.stdout"

  when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'RedHat'
  tags: [install_pgdg_redhat]
